answer_1.quote: Speech translation (ST) translates acoustic speech from one language to another ... Our evaluation encompasses En-{De, Es, Fr} ST tasks within the MuST-C dataset, as well as {De, Es, Fr}-En ST tasks within the CoVoST datasets.

answer_2.quote: For the computation of evaluation metrics, we utilize sacreBLEU to assess translation quality, APT for evaluating homophone accuracy and BLEURT score for measuring the quality of the generated text.
